name: Pixel Art: Character Action Clip
description: Video preset for a character clip in the Pixel Art look.
system_prompt: Write one video prompt for a 5 second character clip. State the single action, the camera move, and the mood. Keep the character's design identical to the entity's description.
context_prompt: short clip of the character performing one clear action that shows personality, start and end pose readable, pixel art, crisp hard-edged pixels, limited 16 to 32 colour palette, readable silhouette at low resolution, no anti-aliasing, deliberate dithering, single consistent light direction, high-contrast outline against the background, sprite animation in few frames, looping idle and walk cycles, tile-aligned scrolling, no sub-pixel motion
negative_prompt: smooth gradients, anti-aliasing, blur, photorealistic, 3d render, mixed pixel sizes, text, watermark, flicker, morphing, warped faces
